title: Saves my back
text: Saves my back. This is great, second one I purchased.  Works well and I put mine on a timer so it runs every day same time.  It picks up dog and cat hair, easy to empty.  I love that it saves my bad back from the ache and pain of a regular vaccumn cleaner.
